name: Slicing Plane Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering algorithm using view-aligned slicing planes intersecting a 3D density volume, processed in front-to-back order with blending.
summary: Slicing Plane Volume Rendering decomposes a 3D volume into view-aligned 2D planes rasterized front-to-back, differing from standard methods by using explicit geometric primitives instead of ray-marching.
